CustomSite.description: Hosts the ApexAgent MCP server — the resource-server endpoint (/services/apexrest/ApexAgent/mcp) that MCP clients connect to for tool discovery and execution. Serves RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata and a 401 challenge to unauthenticated requests so clients can discover the authorization server; all actual authentication happens via Salesforce's native OAuth (org-level, not this site). Once a client presents a valid token, this same endpoint dispatches MCP JSON-RPC requests (server/discover, tools/list, tools/call) running as the real authenticated user's own permissions. Guest access is scoped to exactly two Apex classes and performs no data access.
